prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one reusable transparent PNG tutorial pointer for the KidsPhonics children's Flutter app.
Primary request: Generate a single chunky yellow guide arrow matching the glossy 3D cartoon guide arrow in the supplied KidsPhonics introduction reference: the arrow points diagonally DOWN AND RIGHT, with its tail at the upper-left and broad arrowhead at the lower-right. This is an isolated UI asset, not a screenshot.
Subject and silhouette: short thick straight shaft, large broad triangular arrow head, rounded friendly corners, unmistakable down-right pointing direction. Front-facing flat icon perspective, gently inflated candy-like 3D bevel.
Materials and palette: bright lemon-yellow face with a golden-yellow beveled edge and orange-gold shading, clean glossy white highlight on the upper-left edge. Surround the arrow with a thin cream-white inner stroke, a thick hot-pink/magenta outline, and an outer purple rim with a restrained soft pink magical glow.
Accents: a few small four-point white and warm-yellow sparkles just outside the arrow, similar to the reference. Keep them close to the arrow so the asset reads clearly when small.
Composition: square canvas, one arrow centered, about 80% of canvas, complete arrow, complete glow and sparkles visible with transparent padding on all sides.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, including the corners. No classroom, no character, no buttons, no text, no labels, no logo, no watermark, no checkerboard baked into the pixels. Do not generate any mockup or additional arrows.
